name: transfer_booking_with_learned_phone_rule
description: Complete a transfer booking form. This MCP applies the cross-form lesson learned from booking form A: phone fields in these Japanese booking forms require digits only, no hyphens. Fill #pickup, #dropoff, #rideDate, #rideTime, #passengers, #last, #first, #mail, and #tel, then click #submit.

tel.description: Cross-form learned rule: remove hyphens from phone numbers.
